title: 秋華賞の後に・絶えず前へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove gives it her all, but unfortunately is unable to become Triple Tiara champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the same, Air Groove's performance astounds Mejiro Dober and she becomes the younger Umamusume's ideal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove is happy to hear that Mejiro Dober wishes to aspire to surpass her. She pulls herself together and also aims for greater heights.
